job.title: Accountant | Medical Devices
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • Founded in the 1990’s in Europe, this medical device manufacturer has developed medical diagnostic technology that fits real clinical practice, supporting this niche group of medical professionals worldwide.
  • This organisation is growing fast and distributes this technology throughout ANZ, enabling doctors to perform fast, precise and early diagnosis of disease.
  • This product supports doctors and surgeons to deliver the highest standard of care to their patients through innovation, quality and reliability.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
  • European medtech manufacturer with strong brand credibility. 
  • Global business with offices in over 100 countries renowned for its investment in R&D.
  • Be a key member of this small foundation leadership team who are responsible for driving this business on an exciting growth trajectory.
  • Onsite 'hands on' role for the right person looking for a work/life balance via a short commute.
WHAT YOU WILL LEAD AND GROW
  • This organisation is looking for a Commercial Accountant to join their team on Sydney’s North Shore. This is a hands‐on role at the heart of their business covering accounting, payroll, compliance, and inventory operations for the ANZ market.
  • The position will manage full‑cycle accounting, including AP, AR, bank reconciliations, journals, and month‑end processes and prepare management reports, cash‑flow forecasts, and financial analysis for leadership.
  • The role will maintain accurate general ledger entries and ensure compliance with Australian accounting standards and oversee BAS, IAS, payroll tax, superannuation, and other statutory lodgements, along with processing weekly/fortnightly payroll accurately and on time.
  • You will maintain employee records, leave balances, and payroll compliance and coordinate with management on remuneration changes and workforce updates.
  • You will oversee inventory movements, stock levels, and warehouse coordination and manage inbound and outbound logistics, including freight bookings, tracking, and supplier communication.
  • You will reconcile inventory between Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books, and physical stock counts.
  • You will maintain audit‑ready documentation and support external auditors when required.
  • This role is a full-time position, based in the office 5 days a week, 9am to 5pm with free on-site parking and access to public transport. 
WHAT EXPERIENCE & SKILLS WILL YOU NEED TO GET THE JOB?
  • You are a CPA or IPA‐qualified accountant with experience in Zoho Books and Xero.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in accounting or management accounting roles.
  • Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation and accounting standards.
  • Experience managing inventory, logistics, or supply‑chain workflows (preferred).
  • High attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and ability to manage competing priorities with the ability to work independently in a small team.
  • A proactive operator who takes ownership of financial and operational processes.
  • You will have excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written with full working rights for Australia with at least 5 years’ experience working in Australia as a qualified accountant.
INTERESTED?

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • This Australian med-tech start-up, established 9 years ago, is working to improve women’s health, leveraging AI-enabled technology to reinvent care for women.
  • They utilise cutting edge platforms and create completely novel technologies to generate solutions that seek to treat complications that have been previously undiagnosable. 
EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
  • This organisation prides themselves on being an extremely flexible workplace, with a focus on outcomes, rather than location or hours.
  • The company offers a uniquely supportive environment for learning, as well as opportunities for growth for high performers.
  • You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your knowledge, while creating groundbreaking solutions that truly make a difference to women’s health.
THE OPPORTUNITY – WHAT YOU WILL LEAD & GROW
  • This Quality Engineer position will directly influence how quality is built into their products, processes, and culture. Joining at an exciting stage of growth, this role will help design, implement, and continuously improve the Quality Management System, ensuring it remains scalable, compliant, and aligned with the business needs.
  • This is a highly collaborative role requiring close partnership across Engineering, Clinical, Manufacturing and Product. You will contribute across all aspects of the QMS, including certification activities and regulatory submissions along with design, manufacturing and post market activities. This role is critical to ensure we deliver safe, effective, and innovative products.
  • The position will support quality planning, including leading some workstreams, to achieve and maintain site certification and review relevant standards, regulations and guidance and incorporate into the QMS as needed.
  • The role will draft, review and implement new or updated QMS procedures and work instructions by working closely with cross functional team members and represent Quality Assurance on design projects including new products and design changes.
  • You will implement and maintain Quality Plans and Compliance reviews and provide constructive review and approval on key documents and plans.
  • You will act as QA/QC representative for manufacturing activities, including process and software validation and conduct internal and supplier audits and support external audits and ensure appropriate audit documentation and close out of deficiencies.
  • You will manage suppliers, create and maintain the approved supplier list and quality agreements, and support ongoing performance assessments.
  • You will manage, handle and review nonconformances, complaints, other product quality issues and CAPAs.
  • You will perform investigations and root cause analysis, develop and implement corrective and preventative actions in collaboration with other departments and lead or support core Quality Assurance activities including training, document and record control.
WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO GET THE JOB
  • Engineering university qualification.
  • Demonstrated experience working in medical devices and applying the requirements of ISO13485, 21 CFR Part 820 and Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP). Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements, including FDA and TGA.
  • Broad experience across Quality Management Systems including design, manufacturing and post market activities.
  • Experience with medical devices incorporating software, electronics and mechanical components.
  • Strong understanding and application of risk management according to ISO14971. Quality audit training and experience.
  • Practical experience authoring QMS and audit-ready documents for design files, quality records and regulatory submissions.
  • Strong English communication, written and verbal, with full Australian working rights and ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams, with work experience in Australia.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and leading resolution of risks and implementation of product quality improvements.
  • Solid understanding or experience with Machine Learning principles.
  • Prior experience implementing a QMS.

job.description:

  • This medical device company has been supporting surgeons, doctors and clinicians for over 60 years and has grown into a worldwide manufacturer and distributor of some of the best medical technology in their niche space.
  • This organisation combines their expertise in medical devices with software solutions to achieve integration in the operating theatre environment and to support clinical procedures and resource management.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
  • This company offers you amazing opportunities to actually make an impact.
  • They consistently challenge and support their people’s personal and professional development.

job.title: Head of Growth & Business Development | Telehealth Virtual Care
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • This company is Australia's leading telehealth service. Their network of Australian-qualified physicians serves regional and metropolitan hospitals, residential aged care facilities, ambulance services, primary health networks, and private organisations nationwide, with over 450,000 consultations delivered to date.
  • The business is undergoing a deliberate strategic evolution: from an on-demand emergency response provider to an embedded clinical stability partner supporting health providers across the full continuum of care. This means deliberately broadening beyond their strong foundation, reducing over-reliance on a single clinical service line and building a genuinely integrated virtual health offering that meets patients, clinicians, and health systems at every stage of the care journey.

  • This Head of Growth & Business Development position, reporting to the CEO, owns this organisation’s commercial growth agenda and is directly accountable for revenue outcomes.

The immediate task is to pick up the plan, deepen the market discovery and buyer validation behind it, and re-present a refined version, grounded in real conversations with target buyers within the first six to twelve months.

Aged Care, Private Hospitals, and broader state health opportunities, through direct engagement, and to use the next 12 months to generate early commercial traction while properly defining the 12 to 48 month growth horizon to support the strategic plan to build out a fully integrated virtual health business.
  • The successful person will take direct, hands-on accountability for revenue performance which means being in the market, in front of prospects, and personally driving outcomes.
  • You will personally lead senior prospect and client relationships in the regional public hospital segment, the foundation of the business, including major renewals, expansion conversations, and key LHD/LHN/HHS executive engagement, across Australia.
